body: Entry offsets/sizes address logical bytes. Storage blocks address physical bytes relative to the manifest end. Derived entries reconstruct exact original bytes from same-track stored sources. World chunks remain identity ranges.
authority: Only the host world supplies match statistics; client worlds retain their original clocks and recorded trust results.
client_failure: Retain previous completed desync and roster mismatch reasons. Also omit an embedded client world when its structurally validated restored recording has a build incompatible with the selected host engine; retain exact build and numeric identity without a simulation claim. Host verification remains mandatory. Corrupt sources, unsupported layouts, crashes, timeouts and other errors still fail.

storage.validation: All original entry hashes and physical block hashes are retained; table and network range hashes bind decoded bytes.
